style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#333333;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=10;spacingTop=5;verticalAlign=top;" value="Data Flow Summary:

1. User opens app → Clerk checks auth state
2. Unauthenticated → Login screen
3. Sign in → Clerk issues JWT session
4. Home screen → fetches documents via API (JWT bearer)
5. Upload → API returns S3 pre-signed URL → client uploads directly to S3
6. View/Download → API returns S3 pre-signed GET URL → client opens in browser
7. 15min inactivity → auto sign-out
8. Code push to main → Azure Pipeline builds web → deploys to Cloudflare Pages
9. EAS Build → produces native binaries → submits to App Store / Play Store" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="200" width="500" x="830" y="900" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="conn4" edge="1" parent="1" source="api-presigned" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;strokeColor=#b85450;fontColor=#b85450;fontSize=10;labelBackgroundColor=none;labelPosition=center;verticalLabelPosition=top;align=center;verticalAlign=bottom;" target="s3" value="Pre-signed URLs"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="925" y="541.38" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div:
Stage 1: Build
(ubuntu-latest)
1. Node.js 22.x
2. npm cache (Cache@2)
3. npm install
4. expo export --platform web
5. Publish artifact (dist/)

Stage 2: Deploy
(depends on Build)
1. Install Wrangler CLI
2. Download artifact
3. Rename node_modules
→ vendor_modules
4. Update file references
5. wrangler pages deploy

div.div:
Data Flow Summary:
1. User opens app → Clerk checks auth state
2. Unauthenticated → Login screen
3. Sign in → Clerk issues JWT session
4. Home screen → fetches documents via API (JWT bearer)
5. Upload → API returns S3 pre-signed URL → client uploads directly to S3
6. View/Download → API returns S3 pre-signed GET URL → client opens in browser
7. 15min inactivity → auto sign-out
8. Code push to main → Azure Pipeline builds web → deploys to Cloudflare Pages
9. EAS Build → produces native binaries → submits to App Store / Play Store
